title: Attack on Inirea
description:
Вышло обновлениеVersion 1.0.3 is now available for Windows, mac OS, Linux and Steam OS. This version brings minor enhancements to the achievements system.

Об игреThe peaceful village of Inirea is under attack and needs your help to defend it from monsters.

In this family-friendly arcade-style shooter,  you will take command of powerful weapons to defend the village from hordes of monsters, gaining points and powerups as you progress through the maps.

The game consists of several maps, each with their unique characteristics, weapons and waves of enemies. Procedurally generated enemies ensure an exciting gaming experience every time you play the game.

Some of the maps will require you to defend multiple bases simultaneously. In maps that have multiple bases, you can click on a base to take control of the base. Any bases that you are not actively controlling will function as automatic towers and will track and fire at the nearest enemy.

Several of the larger enemies drop powerups which you can pick up to temporarily upgrade the capabilities of a base.
